changeSet.author: cmr
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE cmr_datasource ADD COLUMN last_test_connected TINYINT(1) COMMENT '最近测试是否连通:null=未测试/不适用' AFTER auth_config, ADD COLUMN last_test_status_code INT COMMENT '最近测试 HTTP 状态', ADD COLUMN last_test_latency_ms BIGINT COMMENT '最近测试耗时 ms', ADD COLUMN last_test_message VARCHAR(512) COMMENT '最近测试结果说明', ADD COLUMN last_test_time DATETIME COMMENT '最近测试时间' AFTER last_test_message;
